description: This file contains utility functions and type definitions for handling encoding, hashing, and error handling in a Fastify-based API project. It includes functions for base64 URL encoding, SHA-256 hashing, and error wrapping for promises and synchronous functions.

methods.name: base64URLEncode
methods.description: Encodes a Buffer into a base64 URL-safe string by replacing '+' with '-', '/' with '_', and removing '=' padding.

methods.name: mapErr
methods.description: Wraps a promise to catch errors and return a Result object indicating success or failure.

methods.name: syncMapErr
methods.description: Wraps a synchronous function to catch thrown errors and return a Result object indicating success or failure.
